limits: EFTA01975333 proves Epstein made the suggestion about contacting Putin; it does not prove Putin received, answered or accepted it.
EFTA02396786 does not identify whom Epstein had asked or join that inquiry to Putin.
EFTA00450694 establishes scheduling for a house visit, not overnight lodging.
The Qatar thread establishes active business-development contact through Carbyne CEO Amir Elichai and Lysys WLL, but no located source proves a bid, NDA, contract, payment or deployment.

No matching 'second of two emails' or primary record identifying the anti-drone information source/provider was located after reconciling the public/DOJ chain, local Barak/DOJ indexes, and the original 40,976-message NAS raw-mail archive. The raw archive's latest parsed message is March 12, 2018, before the 2019 request.
Barak counsel's no-bid account is attributed participant-side evidence and should not be treated as an independent procurement record.
Later Barzan/RBAT and SCS public records show other World Cup counter-UAS channels but do not prove the totality of Qatar's anti-drone architecture.
The 2014 Light & Strong drone-investment lane and the May 2018 'trae'/Carbyne contact are real historical context but are not document-level evidence of the 2019 anti-drone supplier.

Levitection was tested because of its advanced-radar technology and Barak/Epstein investment discussions. The located Q product is for near-field concealed-weapons detection; no source located joins it to the 2019 Qatar anti-drone request.
